title: Taming etcd: Disk I/O, Snapshots, & Compaction for Performance
description: Is your Kubernetes cluster slow? We're diving deep into etcd performance bottlenecks – disk I/O, snapshotting, and compaction – and how to fix them.
linkedinHook: Your Kubernetes cluster is only as fast as its slowest etcd fsync – and it's probably slower than you think.
linkedinBody: Just shipped a deep dive on etcd performance. If you've ever battled slow API responses or mysterious cluster instability, this one's for you. We're breaking down disk I/O, snapshotting, and compaction to keep your etcd snappy.
